author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam finally meets a real-life Wall-E robot! Robot and droid builder Matt Hobbs brings his incredible remote controlled Wall-E to Adam's workshop to show off the latest advances in the Wall-E builder's group and the Kyber Control System used to puppeteer and bring this beloved character to life. 

Find Matt's work at: https://www.youtube.com/@matthobbs7350 and https://www.instagram.com/mattsdroids/
Wall-E Builders Forum: https://wallebuilders.club/forums/
Wall-E Builders Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/215607066346
Kyber Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1341505756182087
Kyber Discord: https://discordapp.com/channels/245451488237846528/1391627106257207439

Shot and edited by Josh Self
Music by Jinglepunks
